title: row_to_message falls back silently for null sender_msg_id masking DB invariant violation
description: row_to_message(): sender_msg_id.unwrap_or_else(|| id.clone()) silently falls back when sender_msg_id is NULL, even though V6 trigger enforces NOT NULL. NULL means DB corruption or pre-V6 data; the fallback papers over it and makes the message appear valid. Better: return Err on NULL, matching how negative size_bytes is rejected.
